name: Pricion – Dynamic Pricing For WooCommerce
author: wpxqw

sections.description:
Pricion – Dynamic Pricing For WooCommerce allows store owners to globally adjust product prices — either apply a discount or surcharge, based on a fixed amount or a percentage of the product’s original price.

Key Features:

  • Apply a discount or surcharge globally to all products.
  • Support for both fixed amount and percentage adjustments.
  • Works on:
    • Shop/archive pages
    • Single product pages
    • Cart/checkout
    • Variable product variations
  • Option to skip on-sale products from adjustment.
  • Option to skip products where the calculated price is less than or equal to zero.
  • Lightweight: entire plugin contained in a single file.
  • Uses the official WordPress Settings API.
  • Fully translatable (Text Domain: pxqdping).
  • Integrates directly under the WooCommerce menu in the WordPress admin.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/pxqdping directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Dynamic Pricing to configure your settings.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin affect prices on variable products?

Yes, prices of individual product variations are adjusted accordingly.

Can I use both discount and surcharge at the same time?

No, only one adjustment type (discount or surcharge) can be active at a time.

Does this plugin work with other pricing or discount plugins?

It depends on how those plugins calculate pricing. This plugin operates at the WooCommerce price retrieval level, so compatibility may vary.

Is it safe to use on a live store?

Yes. It’s tested with the latest WooCommerce and WordPress versions and does not modify original product data.
